families.axis: bare possession of a body → a body specified closely enough to flatter or fault

members.gloss: having a body or a body of a specified kind; often used in combination
members.tone: The unmarked base of the set - it says only that a body is there, or that one of a stated kind is, and waits for a word in front of it to say which.

members.gloss: invested with a bodily form especially of a human body
members.tone: The one member that treats embodiment as something conferred rather than measured, and it carries a gravity the shape words never reach for.
Praises suppleness rather than outline - where *slim-bodied* reports a shape, this admires the ease of one.
Pure measurement along a single axis, and a comparative one at that - it reports length against other bodies without admiring or faulting it.
Measures across where *long-bodied* measures along, and is just as uncommitted about whether narrowness is a virtue.
Names a whole outline instead of one dimension - the most purely geometric word here and the least interested in judging what it draws.
The mirror of *long-bodied* and just as flat - shortness is given as a proportion, not held against the thing that has it.
Names the colour flatly, letting the metal's name stand in for the shade.
The suffix softens the same colour into resemblance - a sheen suggested where *silver-bodied* names the shade outright.
Slimness stated with quiet approval - the plainest of the favourable three, complimentary without reaching for grace.
The same slimness with the compliment drained out - where *slim-bodied* approves, this can land as merely scant.
The most admiring way to report slimness, lending it an elegance *thin-bodied* withholds.
Reports surface rather than dimension, and the agreeableness in it belongs to the texture rather than to any verdict on the body.
The one dimension word here that can land as a verdict instead of a measurement, reading as bulk where *slim-bodied* reads as trim.

families.axis: bare totalizing → totalizing that also condemns

members.gloss: not diminished or moderated in intensity or severity; sometimes used as an intensifier
members.tone: Names the absence of relief - the intensity or severity has had nothing taken off it - where *utter* only says the quality is entire.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Openly contemptuous rather than merely absolute - it disparages the thing it magnifies, where *complete* only measures it.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: The plainest amplifier of the set - it adds fullness and takes whatever scorn is already in the noun.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Totalizes with an air of accomplishment, as though the quality had been brought to a finish, and that mismatch gives it a wryness *utter* has none of.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Condemning - it presents the quality as set fast and past removing, going further than *thorough*, which only says it runs all the way through.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Carries exasperation into the intensifier, insisting the quality will not let up, where *utter* simply fixes its extent.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Blunt and coarse - it enlarges the quality and looks down on it in a single move.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Turns a word of flawlessness into a measure of extent, and gains its edge over *complete* through that mismatch.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Intensifies by denying any admixture - the quality stands undiluted, which is a different claim from *utter*'s nothing-left-over.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: British and profane - the most abusive of these, spending contempt before it has said anything about degree at all.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Bleak in its emphasis, leaving the quality bare and unrelieved rather than merely entire as *complete* does.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Makes the quality conspicuous as well as total - impossible to overlook, where *utter* says nothing about how visible it is.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Amplifies by saying the quality runs the whole way through, a claim about extent with no scorn of its own.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Heavier on the tongue than *thorough*, and the extra weight is insistence on completeness rather than added disparagement.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: Flat and absolute - it allows no remainder, and unlike *arrant* it supplies no sneer of its own.

members.gloss: without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
members.tone: The most deliberate of these amplifiers, spelling out that nothing has been mixed in to weaken the quality where *pure* asserts it in a breath.

families.axis: a mismatch with established procedure → an offense against accepted standards

members.gloss: not suitable or right or appropriate
members.tone: The flattest disapproval here - it marks a thing as not fitting without naming the standard it fails, where *unseemly* and *indecent* both point at one.

members.gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
members.tone: Blunt and severe where *indecorous* is measured - the same breach of what polite society accepts, named with nothing held back.

members.gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
members.tone: Formal and cool, faulting the breach as a lapse of decorum rather than an outrage, which is exactly where it parts from *indecent*.

members.gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
members.tone: Measures the breach against whoever commits it - the conduct falls below what suits them, where *indecorous* faults the conduct alone.

members.gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
members.tone: Faint and formal - it registers the breach of accepted standards as unattractive rather than shocking, staying well back from *indecent*.

members.gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
members.tone: Firm and plain-spoken: the conduct does not fit at all, which is more pointed than *indecorous* and less scandalized than *indecent*.

members.gloss: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society
members.tone: The most restrained of this set, glancing at the breach rather than rebuking it as *unseemly* does.
Mild in shape but broad in reach - it runs from merely improper right through to offensive, and the understatement is what makes the far end land.
The spaced spelling carries the same span, improper at its softest and offensive at its hardest, with no more heat in it than *out-of-the-way*.

members.gloss: not in accord with established usage or procedure
members.tone: Purely a measure against established usage or procedure - it records a mismatch rather than passing judgement, which is what separates it from *improper*.

members.gloss: not in accord with established usage or procedure
members.tone: Cooler and more technical than *wrong* - the same failure to accord with established procedure, stated as a matter of record.

families.axis: plain expectation of a good outcome → optimism so complete it no longer checks against fact

members.gloss: expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds
members.tone: The unmarked term for expecting the best, and the only one here that neither congratulates the expectation nor doubts it.
Positional rather than evaluative: it names an expectation that prices will rise, taking no view of the person holding it the way *optimistic* does.
Leads with the pleasantness and leaves the unrealism in the background, where *pollyannaish* brings it to the front.
Hangs its whole weight on the unrealistic half of the same pleasant optimism, so the good cheer itself becomes the failing.
Buoyant and forward-leaning where *cheerful* is merely pleasant, and it carries the least doubt of the three.
Puts the optimism into what is being shown rather than into the one holding it, so it colours a view instead of judging a temperament.
The shorter, warmer form beside *rose-colored*, and the readier of the two to stand as simple praise for how a prospect looks.
Marks the optimism as a fault either way — whether it has outrun the facts or never met them — and the dreaminess is the point.
Adds steadiness to the cheer: confidence held, not merely expectation entertained, which is what lifts it past *optimistic*.
The heavier, more formal twin of *sanguine* for the same confident cheer, the weight falling on the word rather than the mood.

families.axis: a mild dip in spirits → spirits utterly cast down

members.gloss: affected or marked by low spirits
members.tone: The plain, unmarked word for the state - it reports low spirits without the finality of *amort* or the weather of *gloomy*.
Absolute rather than graded - 'utterly' leaves no degrees to argue about, putting it at the far end from a merely *low* mood.
Identical in sense to *chopfallen*, and like it stresses being brought low - a spirit put down from a height rather than one that was always down.
The blunter-sounding twin of *chapfallen*: the force is in the fall, not in the level reached.
Implies the spirit stood higher before it was lowered, which *gloomy* and *low* do not.
Flatness rather than darkness - the spirit reads as having gone out of something, the mildest and most deadpan of the brought-low set.
Suffuses rather than strikes - the despondency reads as a settled climate around the person, where *deflated* reads as one blow.
Hard-edged where *gloomy* is merely overcast - melancholy that has set and will not be coaxed out of.
The softest word here - it makes despondency sound like a passing shade, understating what the sense actually covers.
States the weight flatly and without consolation, none of the softening that *blue* or *down* carry.
Names the loss rather than the mood - the spirit has been drained out, which registers as depletion beside *gloomy*'s heaviness.
Informal and brief; it says the level and stops, understating beside *depressed*.
More picture than *down* - the whole bearing is lowered, not only the mood.
Gentle and sympathetic, seating the despondency in the heart and inviting comfort where *grim* forecloses it.
Informal and faintly wry - it points at a visible droop instead of naming the feeling, making the state sound smaller than it is.
The barest term available - it gives the level and nothing else, so *downhearted*'s warmth and *grim*'s hardness both fall away.

families.axis: strangeness conspicuous enough to be a verdict → plain non-conformity

members.tone: The flat, judgement-free naming of the departure itself, which *bizarre* and *outlandish* charge up into a verdict.
Treats the unconventionality as something chosen, and a choice is describable without being deplored.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: Strong and faintly appalled — the oddity is loud enough to unsettle, not merely to be noticed.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: The most tolerant reading of the same conspicuous oddity, allowing it to be indulged where *freakish* will not.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: Pushes the strangeness toward the unnatural, so the deviation sounds like a defect of kind rather than a quirk.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: The informal, offhand counterpart to *freakish*, registering the strangeness as a jolt rather than a fault.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: Informal and dismissive — the oddity is treated as too insubstantial to be taken seriously.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: The variant spelling of *flaky*, carrying the identical shrug at strangeness that will not be weighed.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: Informal and almost relishing — the same conspicuous excess sounds enjoyed here, where *freakish* deplores it.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: Informal and blunt, putting the oddity outside any expected range without making it a flaw of character.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: The strangeness is excessive to the edge of absurdity, and the word scorns it where *eccentric* would indulge it.

members.gloss: conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
members.tone: Formal and cool, naming the same conspicuous strangeness with a raised eyebrow instead of *outlandish*'s scorn.

members.gloss: marked by a carefree unconventionality or disreputableness
members.tone: Puts its weight on the carefreeness itself, which is what the word names whether the result reads as dash or as disrepute.

members.gloss: marked by a carefree unconventionality or disreputableness
members.tone: Tilts toward the disreputable half of the sense, though the carefreeness keeps it amused rather than condemning.

members.gloss: marked by a carefree unconventionality or disreputableness
members.tone: Hears dash in the same carefree disrepute that *raffish* hears a shabbiness in.
Informal, and the striking quality lands as a thrill rather than a fault — the approving end of a family whose middle condemns.

families.axis: bare merit worth acknowledging → merit that sets the standard for others

members.gloss: having worth or merit or value; being honorable or admirable
members.tone: The plain baseline of the family, covering both simply having value and being honorable, without fixing what praise is owed.
The most demonstrative way to claim high praise, casting approval as something shown rather than merely stated, where *commendable* keeps it measured.
Measured and official, granting high praise as though it were being formally entered rather than felt.
The most formal of the high-praise set, elevated enough to sound ceremonious beside plainer *praiseworthy*.
Names high praise directly and without ornament, saying what *laudable* says with none of its formality.
Praise with a ceiling built in - it grants real merit while conceding the commendation is a limited one, stopping well short of *commendable*.
A fixed formal honors formula, conferring academic distinction by rank instead of describing what earned it.

members.gloss: (often used ironically) worthy of being treated in a particular way
members.tone: Neutral on its face: it fixes only that some treatment is fitting, never that the treatment is a good one, which is exactly what lets it turn ironic.

members.gloss: (often used ironically) worthy of being treated in a particular way
members.tone: The barer form of the same judgement, stating that a treatment is merited without the weight *deserving* carries, and equally able to land ironically.
The strongest claim here - not merely praised but held up as the standard others should copy.
Fastens to the thing as a label rather than a verdict, naming it the pattern to be imitated where *exemplary* judges it.

members.gloss: with high honor; with high academic distinction
members.tone: The graded step above *cum laude*, raising the honor a rank while keeping the same formal formula.
Adds the idea of something owed - the praise is earned, and a reward is due along with it.
The plainer formation of the same claim, carrying the earned reward without the ceremonious ring of *meritorious*.

members.gloss: suitable for or worthy of quotation
members.tone: The mildest and most particular worth in the family, judging fitness for quotation as much as merit in it.
Asks for reverence rather than applause - what it marks is to be respected or given over to, not simply admired as *worthy* things are.

families.axis: not copied from a model → unprecedented enough to found what follows

members.gloss: being or productive of something fresh and unusual; or being as first made or thought of
members.tone: Does double duty - mild approval for something fresh and unusual, and a flat statement that a thing stands as first made or thought of.
Approval for newness pushed to its edge, where the break with what came before is the whole of the claim - a bigger assertion than *fresh* makes.
Praises the same radical newness as *avant-garde* but hears nerve in it, as though the thing is new because someone risked making it so.

members.gloss: done by hand without mechanical aids or devices
members.tone: Purely a statement of method - the hand working without mechanical aid or device - and it carries none of the approval the words beside it do.

members.gloss: done by hand without mechanical aids or devices
members.tone: Says exactly what *freehand* says and no more, still describing how a thing was done rather than passing any judgement on it.

members.gloss: original and of a kind not seen before
members.tone: The warmest of the three that share this sense: not merely without precedent but welcome for it, where *new* only records the absence.

members.gloss: original and of a kind not seen before
members.tone: The plainest way to make the claim - a thing is original and unlike anything seen before - with almost no approval loaded onto it.

members.gloss: original and of a kind not seen before
members.tone: Cooler and more formal than *fresh*, treating the unlikeness to anything before as a fact worth remarking rather than a pleasure.
Praise pointed forward - the thing is valued for the later development it holds in seed, not for what it already amounts to.
The flattest of the three: it credits the power to start something without *germinal*'s picture of a seed and its growth.
The heaviest praise here, treating the thing as the source everything afterwards grows out of - a standing *germinal* only promises.

members.gloss: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
members.tone: Approval that lands on the making: not simply that a thing is unprecedented but that someone brought something unprecedented about.

members.gloss: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
members.tone: The dry variant of *innovative*, sounding more like a classification of the thing than any compliment paid to it.

members.gloss: being or producing something like nothing done or experienced or created before
members.tone: The most emphatic way to say it - first through unbroken ground - where *innovative* states the same feat without the flourish.
Praise made by subtraction: it clears a thing of owing itself to a source and of copying a model, without claiming freshness the way *original* does.
